309tommy_inline tommy_hashdyn_node* tommy_hashdyn_bucket(tommy_hashdyn* hashdyn, tommy_hash_t hash)
310{
311 return hashdyn->bucket[hash & hashdyn->bucket_mask];
312}

325tommy_inline tommy_hashdyn_node* tommy_hashdyn_find(tommy_hashdyn* hashdyn, tommy_search_func* cmp, const void* cmp_arg, tommy_hash_t hash)
326{
327 tommy_hashdyn_node* i = tommy_hashdyn_bucket(hashdyn, hash);
328
329 while (i) {
330 /* we first check if the hash matches, as in the same bucket we may have multiple hash values */
331 if (i->index == hash && cmp(cmp_arg, i->data) == 0)
332 return i;
333 i = i->next;
334 }
335 return 0;
336}

349tommy_inline void* tommy_hashdyn_search(tommy_hashdyn* hashdyn, tommy_search_func* cmp, const void* cmp_arg, tommy_hash_t hash)
350{
351 tommy_hashdyn_node* node = tommy_hashdyn_find(hashdyn, cmp, cmp_arg, hash);
352
353 return node ? node->data : 0;
354}
